name: Saimin Reiki
source:
Niru lives his life as a slave. All of a sudden, a demon emerges before him.
“Though you may have been abandoned as an unwanted child, you are in fact the heir to the royal throne,” explains the demon. “How would you like to claim your revenge with my powers to manipulate the human mind?”

Niru signs a contract with the demon and obtains its powers. He murders his twin brother, the prince, and takes his place.
Then he proceeds to turn his hatred on his mother, the queen, and his sister, the princess.
What fate shall befall this man who wields these ungodly powers?

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/saimarureiki-ja/]Johren[/url]]
translation:
尼鲁一生都过着奴隶般的生活。某天，恶魔突然出现在他面前。
“虽然你是被遗弃的弃儿，但其实是王位的继承人。”恶魔解释道，“你愿意借助我操纵人心的力量复仇吗？”

尼鲁与恶魔签订契约，获得了它的力量。他杀死双胞胎兄长王子，取而代之。随后，他把憎恨倾向母亲王后和妹妹公主。

这个掌握亵渎神明般力量的男人，最终将迎来怎样的命运？
